unavailable.title: Izibalo azitholakali okwamanje
unavailable.unconfigured: Indawo yokugcina yokuhlaziya ayikanikwa ithokheni yayo ye-Cloudflare API. Akukho okuboniswayo esikhundleni senani eliqanjiwe.
unavailable.error: Asikwazanga ukufinyelela i-API yokuhlaziya ye-Cloudflare. Kunokuba ibonise inani elidala noma eliqanjiwe, leli khasi alibonisi lutho kuze kuphumelele ukufunda bukhoma.

proof.title: Lapho lezi zibalo zivela khona
proof.subtitle: Kulinganiswe yi-Cloudflare, hhayi yileli khasi
proof.edge: Sonke isicelo esiya ku-dehub.io sidlula ku-Cloudflare ngaphambi kokuba sifike kuma-server ethu. Lezi zibalo ziwukuhlanganiswa kwe-Cloudflare ngokwayo kwaleyo thrafikhi — amanani afanayo abonisa ideshibhodi yethu. Aziqoqwa umbhalo esipheqululini sakho, ngakho akukho lutho kuleli khasi olungawakhulisa, futhi ukuvimba abalandeli akuwashintshi.
proof.live: Ikhasi liwafunda bukhoma. Ukulayisha i-/stats kubiza indawo yethu yokugcina, ebuza i-Analytics API ye-Cloudflare ngaleso sikhathi bese igcina impendulo imizuzwana engu-60.
proof.limits: Okuboniswa yilokhu nokungaboniswa: ungabona ukuthi amanani avela ekuhlanganisweni kwe-Cloudflare hhayi kukhodi yohlelo lwethu, nokuthi umbuzo oshicilelwe lapha yiwona osebenzayo. Akuyona into engadingi ukwethemba — ithokheni ye-API sinayo, futhi i-Cloudflare ayinikezi ukufunda komphakathi kokuhlaziya kwendawo. Noma ubani onendawo yakhe ye-Cloudflare angasebenzisa umbuzo ofanayo futhi aqinisekise isakhiwo sawo.

definitions.title: Okushiwo yilezi zibalo
definitions.visitors: — amakheli e-IP ahlukile i-Cloudflare eyawabona ngalolo suku. Kusondele kubantu, kodwa akufani: ihhovisi elikuxhumano olulodwa libalwa kanye, futhi ifoni eshintsha phakathi kwe-wifi nedatha yeselula ibalwa kabili.
definitions.pageViews: — izicelo i-Cloudflare eziqoqa njengokulayishwa kwamakhasi, hhayi izithombe, imibhalo noma amakholi we-API.
definitions.bots: — lezi yizibalo ezingahluziwe emaphethelweni, ngakho ama-crawler, abaqaphi bokusebenza namaklayenti anemibhalo akufakiwe. Ungazibona wena kubunjalo besiphequluli ngenhla, lapho okufakiwe okufana no-"Curl" no-"Akwaziwa" kuyithrafikhi ezenzakalelayo hhayi abantu. Ukuhlunga ama-bot kudinga uhlelo lwe-Cloudflare olukhokhelwayo esingenalo, futhi ukususa isilinganiso buthule kwenza izibalo zingahloleki kalula, hhayi kangcono.
definitions.total: — ukubukwa kwamakhasi nezicelo kuyahlanganiswa kulo lonke ibanga. Izibalo zezivakashi azihlanganiswa ngamabomu zibe "yisamba sezivakashi", ngoba umuntu obelapha ngoMsombuluko nangoLwesibili ubezobalwa kabili.
definitions.peak: — inani eliphakeme kunawo wonke elihlukile kunoma yisiphi isikhathi esisodwa sebanga, ngesizathu esifanayo: yinani i-Cloudflare eyilinganisa ngempela, hhayi elakhiwe ngokuhlanganisa izibalo ezigqagqanayo.
definitions.resolution: — lona umkhawulo we-Cloudflare kulolu hlelo, hhayi ukukhetha kwethu: yenqaba noma yimuphi umbuzo wamahora obanzi kunezinsuku ezintathu. Ukubuka kwamahora angu-24 nezinsuku ezingu-3 kungokwamahora; izinsuku ezingu-7 nangaphezulu kungokwansuku zonke, futhi ayikho indlela yokudweba ishadi lamahora lesikhathi sonke.
definitions.breakdown: — alandela ibanga olikhethayo, kodwa kuphela izinsuku ezingu-{{max}} emuva, ngoba yilapho ukuhlukaniswa kwansuku zonke kugcinwa khona. Emabangeni amade ishadi limboza isikhathi esingaphezu kohlu lwamazwe.
definitions.start: — "isikhathi sonke" kusho usuku ngalunye i-Cloudflare esalugcinile, namuhla izinsuku ezingu-{{days}} kusukela ngo-{{date}}, usuku i-dehub.io eyathuthela ngalo ku-Cloudflare. Ayikho idatha yasemaphethelweni yangaphambili engaboniswa, futhi izinsuku ezindala ziyawa njengoba i-Cloudflare izenza zibe ndala.

superpowers.boostExplainer: Kubeka lokhu okuthunyelwe endaweni ephezulu kohla lwasekhaya ngesikhathi sakho esabelweyo.
superpowers.cancelledRefunded: Ukukhuthaza kukhanseliwe futhi kubuyiselwe esabelweni sakho
superpowers.cancelledSpent: Ukukhuthaza kukhanseliwe. Kwase kuqalile, ngakho kusasele kusetshenzisiwe.
superpowers.finishedCount: {{count}} kuqediwe kulo mjikelezo, kubonwe izikhathi ezingu-{{seen}}
superpowers.intro: Ibheji lithenga okungaphezu komdwebo osecaleni kwegama lakho. Njalo ngamaviki amabili linika ukukhuthaza — ngakunye kubeka okuthunyelwe endaweni ephezulu kohla lwasekhaya. Amazinga ayi-13, amandla ayi-13, ukuvulwa okukodwa ngezinga ngalinye.
superpowers.loadFailed: Ayikwazanga ukulayisha Amandla Akho manje. Zama futhi emzuzwini.
superpowers.needBadge: Amandla adinga ibheji lokufaka. Faka i-DHB ukuze uwavule.
superpowers.noBadgeYet: Awunalo ibheji okwamanje, ngakho awukho ukukhuthaza. Ukufaka i-DHB kuvula uhlu olungezansi.
superpowers.refillsOn: Kugcwaliswa kabusha ngo-{{date}} — isikhathi esifanayo kubo bonke.
superpowers.secondWindExplainer: Lokhu okuthunyelwe sekudlule iviki. Umoya Wesibili ukubuyisela phezulu ohlwini.
superpowers.shareOfVoice: Indawo yokukhuthaza iyajikeleza. Uma kukhuthazwa okuningi kusebenza ngasikhathi sinye, ababukeli banikwa okulinganiselwa ngezinga lebheji — izinga eliphezulu liboniswa kaningi, futhi wonke umuntu uthola isikhathi anikwe sona.
